prose: David Pantano is the author of Alchemical Hermeticism: The Secret Teachings of Marco Daffi on Initiation. This book translates many previously unavailable writings of this enigmatic mid-20th century Italian sage, complemented by a compelling biography comprised of Pantano's research. Tune in to discover just who was the Baron Richardo Ricciardelli, aka Marco Daffi, and what occult societies permeated Italy during his time? Topics include anamnesis, initiation and aristocracy, hermetic healing methods, psychic abilities and past life consequences.
ext: We dig deeper into Hermetic ideology, such as the laws of the source, ontological creationism, the powerful magic of names, monadic phagocitation and the River Lethe, Eonic encounters in the astral planes, and starting points for self-initiation practices.
